# ==============================================================================
# Spec-born component library (header-only): matrix
#
# Generated structs, dispatch, and the emitted canonical .proto live
# in .auto/ (regenerated by make cdef, pinned by check-cdef); inc/
# holds the once-generated, user-owned stub carrying the logic.
# ==============================================================================

include(apex/All)
apex_module(apex_spec_demo_matrix)

apex_add_interface_library(
  NAME
  ${LIB_NAME}
  INC
  "${INC_DIR}"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.auto"
  DEPS_INTERFACE
  system_core_system_component
  utilities_helpers
  fmt::fmt
)

apex_add_data_manifest(MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/apex_data.toml")
